That's it. And you're supposed to use the ACTUAL numbers from the Dashboard — those beautiful ones, the ones with the blocks around the numbers, those look extraordinary — you're supposed to use those exact pieces. The current one looks rainbow bright, cheap, unpolished, not pro — forget about it, it's garbage. Now you know what garbage looks like, so now do something elite: you can literally just take the pieces from what we already have and apply them to the calendar. Don't create anything new — forget creating new — just take the pieces and craft those pieces and create the calendar out of the pieces you find. And then he added: those are just the image examples. You literally have the real code — just go grab it and use it. Stop trying to reinvent, recreate something new. Whenever you do new, you start at the beginning. Can you honestly think that what you did was the most intelligent beautiful interface you ever saw in your life — or would you think, holy fuck, I'm pretty sure it's the second one?
